seasons.title: Blood and Badges
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms in Hallia, takes courier jobs, and stumbles into a conspiracy of Ugathul infiltrators, illegal augury, and necromantic experiments — culminating in a devastating near-total party kill at the Crowded Flea while ambushing the Roundhat Gang.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: Surviving the TPK through the void between life and death, the party meets the entity Aut, is resurrected at a cost, and pursues vengeance against Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide — killing both and uncovering a cosmic conspiracy of six gods attempting to crack the Firmament via radar dishes.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, competes in gladiatorial trials and scavenger puzzles to earn a keystone, and trades a stolen Kellan Quinn painting to a Heart for passage aboard a colossal Strider bound for the Void Side Wall.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from the dead in divided form, the party enters extended downtime, and a sewer expedition beneath Teller's Run reveals a fracture in reality where an imprisoned god looms — leading the party to bomb the research operation and flee as ash rains over the city.

seasons.title: Aboard the Providence
seasons.arc_summary: The party embarks on the Strider pilgrimage, creates their own Fane-heart named Eerie, builds a coalition of allied factions, and survives the devastating weekly tithe of Voidsong energy that wrings a weaker faction to death and unleashes void portals onto the Strider.

seasons.title: Heart of the Spider
seasons.arc_summary: The party descends deep into the Strider's Undercroft to recover a stolen artifact, battling through mongrel folk and spider cultists of Herald, ultimately awakening an ancient Machine God and forging an alliance to purge the Strider of remaining cultists.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Fall of the Terror
seasons.arc_summary: The 8th-grade heroes of Cagley Middle descend into the Terror of Cagley's lair and slay the shadow demon, saving their town — and a new team of high-ranking Scale operatives is dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure.

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: The Scale team infiltrates the fiend-built Quorum structure, battles through its demonic defenders, and descends through a bloodfall portal to rescue Voice of Many — a trapped divine entity and heir to the Judge — fighting a desperate defense to free it and escape back to headquarters.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: Convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a mysterious visitor, then follow a feyrock necklace deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they battle fey creatures, rescue a lost child, and defeat a fey court — only to learn the huskification curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The investigation shifts back to the city as the convox traces fey stone through a jeweler's conference to a ritual murder scene, where they discover the Gloaming Codex — a book that pulls the entire party into its pages to fight for survival against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: The Sedecium fire team of Old Man Scrazzy, Lieutenant Foral, and Ozzie undertakes perilous missions across the slip — investigating a derelict orbital station to uncover the Thessian Esoterica's interest in a massive magical spike near the Astra's core, and then raiding the divine essence of a freshly-killed god before the God Eater Harrow can consume it entirely.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
